subject: Urgent: short-window quota bump, tolling option, and invoice smoothing request
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@brightcommerce.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unplanned traffic for Oct 22 promotion — quota bump?

Hi Tessa,

We have a flash promotional event scheduled for Oct 22 (US market) and our engineering team just surfaced that estimated inference calls could spike ~6x baseline for a 36–48 hour window. This is coming a bit late in the planning cycle — apologies — but we need to avoid throttles that would break the customer experience.

Can Redwood provisionally increase our quota/rate limit for that short window? Also, if we do exceed the committed threshold, would you consider offsetting the overage via a one-time credit or invoice smoothing (we can accept a modest surcharge but want to avoid an unexpectedly large invoice for the month)?

If helpful I can share a usage snapshot from our staging run. We are the BrightCommerce checkout/upsell team (Marta Ruiz, Head of Platform).

Thanks — really appreciate a quick read on options.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform
BrightCommerce

Attachments: Usage_Snapshot_BrightCommerce_20271017.csv (stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@brightcommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-18T09:39:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unplanned traffic for Oct 22 promotion — quota bump?

Marta — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the snapshot. Short answer: yes, we can help.

High-level proposal (fast path we can stand up before Oct 22):
- Provisional quota bump: temporary uplift to the next capacity tier for a 72-hour window starting Oct 22 00:00 UTC.
- Tolling for overage: instead of immediate full overrun billing, we apply a tiered surcharge (10/25/40%) by incremental consumption band and hold final invoice until we reconcile usage.
- Invoice smoothing / credit: if the event is an isolated spike and you accept a small surcharge, we can issue a partial credit against the next invoice for measured overage after reconciliation.

I attached a short addendum draft (PROV_QUOTA_ADDENDUM.pdf) that outlines the provisional uplift and the tolling bands so you can review. This will need signoff from Sales Ops and Finance for the invoice-credit path (cc’ed Ben + Lauren).

Can you confirm:
1) exact start/end in UTC (your note said ~36–48 hours; we recommend setting a fixed 72-hour window to avoid edge cases)
2) expected QPS peak and approximate token mix (prompt vs completion) so we can pick the right capacity profile

If you sign the addendum we’ll pre-stage capacity and enable an automated fallback to the current quota after the window.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1-415-555-0164

Attachments: PROV_QUOTA_ADDENDUM.pdf (stub)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@brightcommerce.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unplanned traffic for Oct 22 promotion — quota bump?

Tessa — that makes sense and thank you.

We can commit to a 72-hour window starting Oct 22 00:00 UTC. Peak QPS estimate is 1,800 (baseline is ~300), with the mix roughly 70% short prompts and 30% long completions.

Two asks from our side before signing:
- Can the partial credit be applied to the next invoice as a single line item (we want this to flow through procurement without extra paperwork)?
- If we don’t fully consume the provisional uplift, can the unused headroom be rolled forward to the next billing month as a partial credit?

If you can confirm those two items we can sign the addendum and route through procurement.

Best,
Marta

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-18T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: provisional uplift calc and billing path for BrightCommerce

Tessa / Lauren — quick ops note after reviewing Marta’s snapshot and the addendum draft. See attached ops_calc.xlsx for the math.

Recommendation:
- Approve 72-hr provisional uplift (pre-stage capacity).
- Implement tolling model: first 25% over baseline -> 10% surcharge; next 50% -> 25% surcharge; remaining -> 40% surcharge. Hold all charges in reconciliation queue.
- Credit treatment: if the spike is singular and BrightCommerce signs the addendum, finance can issue a single line credit against the following invoice up to 50% of surcharge amount (i.e., we absorb up to half of the surcharge as a goodwill credit). This is contingent on a signed addendum and confirmation of the window.
- Roll-forward: unused uplift cannot be automatically rolled forward; however, we can convert unused uplift into a monetary credit (at the same rate) and apply to next invoice subject to a cap (suggest cap = 30% of the uplift value).

Lauren — need your explicit OK on the credit cap and whether we require a PO amendment for your team to accept the credit as a single line item.

Ben
Head of Sales Ops

Attachments: ops_calc.xlsx (stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@brightcommerce.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@brightcommerce.com
Date: 2027-10-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unplanned traffic for Oct 22 promotion — quota bump? — confirmed path and DocuSign

Marta — thanks again. Per Ben and Lauren we have an agreed path:

Summary of confirmed terms:
- 72-hour provisional quota uplift starting Oct 22 00:00 UTC.
- Tolling bands: 10% / 25% / 40% as consumption bands described in the addendum.
- Invoice treatment: Redwood will hold overage charges in reconciliation and issue a single-line credit on the following invoice for up to 50% of the surcharge amount (goodwill credit), contingent on a signed addendum.
- Unused uplift: will be converted to a monetary credit and applied to the next invoice up to a cap equal to 30% of uplift value.

I’ve uploaded the signed addendum to DocuSign for BrightCommerce approval: https://www.docusign.com/TP/abc123-addendum
Please route to procurement for signature (cc’d). Once signed we’ll pre-stage capacity and confirm the autoscale policy.

If anything above needs tweaked email me urgently — otherwise we’ll assume the window and plan to stage.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
